chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام ruled regarding a woman who made herself available to a slave of hers and he had relations with her, that she be struck one hundred lashes, and that the slave be struck fifty lashes, and that he be sold away from her.
And it is forbidden upon every Muslim to sell her a mature slave after that.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَا: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام in his capacity as ruler and judge
key_terms.جَلْدَةً: a lash as legal corporal punishment

ai.seo_question: What was the ruling of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام regarding a woman who had relations with her male slave?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام concerning unlawful sexual relations between a woman and her male slave. It specifies corporal punishment for both parties, separation of the slave from her through sale, and a further prohibition against selling her another mature male slave.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4572 - Al-Alaa narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said:

"Commander of the Faithful (as) ruled in the case of a woman who allowed her slave to have relations with her and married him:
She is to be given one hundred lashes, and the slave is to be given fifty lashes. The slave is then to be sold in a manner that ensures he is distanced from her (bi-sughrin minha).
It is forbidden for any Muslim to sell her a mature slave after that incident."
